name: Perplexity MCP
tagline: Real-time web search with citations via the Perplexity API.
shortDescription: The Perplexity MCP server. Gives your agent access to Perplexity's real-time web search with source citations. Each search returns ranked results + the actual web pages Perplexity read, with citations.
longDescription:
## What it is

The Perplexity MCP server. Exposes the Perplexity API as MCP tools so your agent can run real-time web searches and get back results with citations. Supports the Sonar models (sonar, sonar-pro, sonar-reasoning) for different depth/cost tradeoffs.

## Why we recommend it

Perplexity is one of the best real-time search APIs available. Each search returns not just ranked URLs but synthesized answers with citations to the actual sources — your agent can verify the claims and follow up on specific sources. For tasks like "what changed in the latest X release" or "compare these two products right now", it's the most useful search API available.

## When to use it

- Real-time research: agent pulls current info on a topic
- Citation tracking: agent cites sources, user can verify
- News monitoring: agent checks for new articles on a topic
- Comparison shopping: agent pulls current pricing and features
installInstructions:
1. Get an API key at https://www.perplexity.ai/settings/api
2. Set `PERPLEXITY_API_KEY=pplx-...`
3. `uvx perplexity-mcp`

**Pricing note:** Perplexity charges per search. The `sonar` model is cheap and fast; `sonar-pro` is higher quality and more expensive; `sonar-reasoning` is best for complex queries.
pricingDetails: Free MCP server. Perplexity API: $5 free credit, then $0.005/search (sonar), $0.015/search (sonar-pro), $0.035/search (sonar-reasoning).
